skill.name: influencer-discovery
skill.description: Build influencer discovery lists from a brand, niche, platform, and follower range. The skill screens creators for fit, engagement, authenticity, and next steps.
skill.summary: Find, screen, and organize influencer candidates across social platforms.
skill.author: aaron-he-zhu

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown links, inline code, and placeholder paths, not executable traversal or shell usage. One optional YouTube metrics instruction includes a real local command using an environment-derived path, so it should remain gated by user consent. No prompt injection or credential-exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.suggestion: Gate the YouTube connector behind explicit user confirmation, invoke it with argv arguments, and reject handles with shell metacharacters or path separators.
State that YOUTUBE_API_KEY must remain in the local environment and should never be pasted into prompts or reports.

content.value_statement: Finding credible creators across platforms takes time and creates inconsistent shortlists. This skill turns campaign criteria into screened influencer candidates, profiles, and next-step recommendations.
actual_capabilities: Captures brand, niche, platform, follower range, engagement floor, location, and exclusions.
Builds a multi-platform candidate pool from hashtags, similar accounts, competitor mentions, and shared handles.
Screens candidates for follower range, engagement, recent activity, content relevance, and brand-safety red flags.
Creates per-influencer profiles with metrics, audience signals, content style, partnership history, and contact path.
Produces a tiered shortlist with summary statistics, platform mix, and recommended next steps.
Can save discovery reports and promote top handles into the configured memory workflow.
limitations: It has no required live integrations and relies on user inputs unless optional connectors are available.
It does not compute the final weighted fit score; it hands candidates to fit-scorer.
Public creator data can be incomplete, so unknown fields should remain marked as unconfirmed.
Contact details are limited to public business paths and should not be guessed.

use_cases.title: Build a New Creator Roster
use_cases.description: Create a screened list of creators for a new campaign, with tiers and early fit signals.

use_cases.title: Find Micro Creators for Launch
use_cases.description: Discover smaller creators in a niche and compare engagement, audience match, and brand safety.

use_cases.title: Map Competitor Creator Activity
use_cases.description: Identify creators used by competing brands and flag saturated partners before outreach planning.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Basic Search
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner search with a niche and brand.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find 20 influencers in [niche] for [brand]. Use Instagram and TikTok. Include follower range, engagement notes, and red flags.

prompt_templates.title: Search by Creator Tier
prompt_templates.scenario: Filter candidates by follower band and campaign need.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find micro creators with 10K to 100K followers for [product]. Prioritize [location], [language], engagement above [percent], and recent activity.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Screened Shortlist
prompt_templates.scenario: Turn a broad pool into a ranked working list.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a shortlist for [campaign goal]. Compare candidates by audience fit, content quality, authenticity signals, contact path, and competitor partnerships.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Handoff Report
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow for scoring and outreach.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a discovery report for [brand]. Include criteria, pool stats, per-platform mix, tiered shortlist, concerns, and next steps for fit-scorer and outreach-manager.

output_examples.input: Find sustainable fashion micro influencers for an eco clothing launch.
output_examples.output: The output lists screened creators by tier, with follower bands, engagement notes, audience fit, brand-safety flags, and recommended next actions.

output_examples.input: Identify YouTube creators for a B2B analytics tool.
output_examples.output: The output profiles relevant channels, summarizes audience and content fit, notes sponsorship saturation, and flags which creators need deeper scoring.

output_examples.input: Refresh a roster after several creators churned.
output_examples.output: The output dedupes against known candidates, adds replacements, and highlights which creators should move to scoring or outreach.

best_practices: Provide campaign goal, audience, platforms, follower range, region, and exclusions before discovery starts.
Verify recent content and comment quality before treating engagement numbers as reliable.
Use the output as a candidate pool, then run fit-scorer before final selection.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to rank a completed shortlist; use fit-scorer for final ranking.
Do not guess private contact details or infer unavailable demographic data.
Do not treat follower count as proof of audience quality or campaign fit.

faq.question: What inputs does this skill need?
faq.answer: It needs a brand or product, niche, target platforms, follower range, campaign goal, location, language, and exclusions.

faq.question: Does it connect to influencer databases?
faq.answer: No live integration is required. It can use optional connector placeholders when the host provides those tools.

faq.question: Can it verify engagement metrics?
faq.answer: It can record visible engagement and optional measured YouTube metrics, but many values depend on public data quality.

faq.question: Does it find private emails?
faq.answer: No. It only records public business emails, public contact forms, agency paths, or platform contact options.

faq.question: How is this different from fit-scorer?
faq.answer: This skill finds and screens candidates. Fit-scorer applies weighted scoring to a known shortlist.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, or Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The metadata lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code compatible skill hosts.
